programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We join Harry Kewell in Vietnam as he embraces a new chapter in coaching, reflecting on a career that took him from prodigious talent to Premier League star. Kewell revisits his electrifying rise at Leeds United, before confronting the intense scrutiny and expectation that came with his move to Liverpool and then Galatasaray. He opens up about the injuries, pressure, and moments at Anfield that nearly drove him away from the game altogether. Now, far from the spotlight, we see a different side o.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We spend the day with Julian Dicks as he reflects on a career that made him one of the Premier League's toughest and most uncompromising defenders. Best known for his time at West Ham United, Dicks looks back on the highs, rivalries and intensity of football in the 1990s, as well as the reputation that made him a cult hero with fans. Now coaching at Chelmsford City, we see a different side to the former hardman as he passes on his experience to the next generation, while reflecting on the moment.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Cup, we revisit the rise of current USA manager Mauricio Pochettino's unforgettable Tottenham Hotspur side; the team that transformed Spurs from top-four hopefuls into genuine challengers at home and in Europe. Playing fearless, high-intensity football and built around a young core of stars, Pochettino's Spurs came within touching distance of Premier League and Champions League glory, creating some of the club's greatest modern nights along the way. Through exclusive interview.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We sit down with Lee Bowyer to look back on the career of one of the Premier League's fiercest and most competitive midfielders. From his rise at Charlton to becoming a key figure in the brilliant Leeds United side that challenged Europe's elite and reached the Champions League semi-finals, Bowyer reflects on the highs, controversies and defining moments of his career, including spells with West Ham, Newcastle and Birmingham. He also opens up about the terrifying plane incident in 1998 that near.

programme.title: GOALS OF THE SEASON - 2025/2026 (HAALAND)
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - ERLING HAALAND'S 100
programme.desc: We celebrate Erling Haaland's record-breaking haul in true Netbusters' style, showcasing every one of his 100 Premier League goals, squeezed into a special 26-minute show.

programme.title: PL STORIES
programme.desc: We celebrate the rise of Norwegian striking power in the Premier League, exploring how a golden generation in the late 1990s; featuring pioneers like Ole Gunnar Solskjær and Tore Andre Flo helped shatter stereotypes and establish Norway as an unlikely breeding ground for elite forwards. Set against the backdrop of a physically demanding homeland that forged resilience and a relentless mentality, the story also weaves in the presence of Alf-Inge Haaland during that same era, creating a generation.

programme.desc: S5 E12 — Olivier Giroud We follow the remarkable journey of Olivier Giroud, from his Premier League days with Arsenal and Chelsea to Champions League glory and beyond. A World Cup winner known for his elegance and resilience, Giroud's career has taken him from London to Milan, then to LA, and now back home with a move to Lille. As he begins this new chapter, we reflect on the highs, the hurdles, and the legacy of one of football's most underrated and enduring strikers.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E13 — Christian Benteke We catch up with Christian Benteke in Washington, where the powerful Belgian striker now leads the line for D.C. United. From his early days in Belgium to his explosive arrival in the Premier League with Aston Villa, followed by big moves to Liverpool and Crystal Palace, Benteke's journey has been one of raw talent, resilience, and reinvention.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E14 — Thiago Silva We join Thiago Silva in his native Brazil to reflect on his remarkable footballing journey; from overcoming life-threatening illness early in his career to becoming one of the world's most respected defenders. We explore his late-career success in the Premier League, his influence on and off the pitch and life at current club Fluminense.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E15 — Edwin van der Sar Edwin van der Sar has faced down pressure on the biggest stages in world football, but his toughest battle came after retirement. In 2023, the legendary goalkeeper suffered a life-threatening brain haemorrhage. In this episode Edwin opens up on his recovery and looks back on his career at the top that redefined goalkeeping. From Champions League glory with Ajax and Manchester United to his commanding presence in the Premier League.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E16 — David Luiz Flamboyant, fearless, and unforgettable - David Luiz lit up the Premier League with his unique style. From Champions League triumphs at Chelsea to high-stakes drama at Arsenal, his career was packed with silverware and great stories. In this episode, we explore the man behind the headlines: a leader, a teammate, and a born entertainer. Now back in Brazil, Luiz opens up on life after the Premier League and his plans for the future.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E17 — Maya Yoshida In this episode, we look back at Yoshida's journey from Japan to England's top-flight, his role as a leader for club and country, and the cultural bridge he helped build along the way. Now in the final stages of his playing career with LA Galaxy in the USA, we catch up with him as he looks to inspire the next generation, both in Japan and around the world.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E18 — AFC Bournemouth: 'From the Brink' In 2024/25, AFC Bournemouth smashed their club record with 56 Premier League points, but less than 20 years earlier, they were drowning in debt and fighting for survival. This is the story of a club that defied the odds, silenced the doubters, and rose to become a certified Premier League contender, with their eyes set on Europe.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E19 — Yaya Touré We chart the remarkable journey of one of the Premier League's most iconic midfielders, Yaya Touré, from his humble beginnings in Bouaké, Ivory Coast, to his rise through European football's elite clubs. We sit down with Touré to discuss his development at ASEC Mimosas, his path playing with the likes of Monaco and Barcelona, and his eventual arrival at Manchester City, where he became a driving force behind the club's transformation into a football powerhouse.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E22 — José Fonte We travel to Portugal to sit down with José, as he reflects on his years in the Premier League, his development as a leader, and the role that English football played in shaping a career that would eventually lead to international glory with Portugal.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E23 — Luc Nilis Still regarded as a legend in his native Belgium, Luc Nilis lit up the Pro League and Dutch football, winning numerous titles and cups with Anderlecht and PSV Eindhoven. His 2000 move to Aston Villa looked set to make him a Premier League star, but instead, it almost ended in tragedy. We catch up with the former striker to hear his incredible story and discover how his new role in coaching has become his biggest challenge yet.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E26 — Premier League Hall of Fame We sit down for an exclusive interview with the first of two new Premier League Hall of fame inductees, Eden Hazard. He reflects on his rise to the top, the moments that defined his career, and the immense pride he feels at joining the elite ranks of the Premier League's greatest ever players.

A story on one of the league's most influential right-backs and a leader whose impact still shapes English football today.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E28 — Regis Le Bris We join Regis Le Bris as he charts his meteoric journey from the training pitches of France to the dugout at Sunderland, where he masterminded an unlikely charge to the Premier League. Le Bris reflects on the philosophy and resilience that helped his side punch far above their weight. We also travel back to France to uncover the formative experiences and influences that shaped one of football's most intriguing modern managers.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E29 — Yankuba Minteh A firm favourite at Brighton and Hove Albion, Yankuba Minteh sits down with PL Stories and opens up on his journey from the streets of The Gambia to the pinnacle of the Premier League. We travel to his hometown to meet his parents and those who first recognised his talent, uncovering the roots of his relentless drive and humility. A story of resilience and rapid ascent, uncovering the challenges he's overcome, and the pride he carries for his home nation.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E30 — The Forgotten Class of '92 Three decades on from Manchester United's iconic Class of '92, PL Stories steps beyond the headline names to rediscover the teammates who shared the same dressing room, dreams, and demands of one of football's most revered youth systems. We sit down with the lesser-known graduates who lived that journey first-hand, players whose paths diverged from the global spotlight but whose experiences offer a rare and revealing window into the reality behind the legend.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E31 — Oliver Glasner A life-threatening head injury ended Oliver Glasner's playing career early, but it did nothing to quell his ambition. We go behind-the-scenes to reveal the makings of a manager who has achieved success throughout the past decade in European management, winning European titles in Germany, and the first major silverware in Crystal Palace's 120-year history.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E32 — Micky van de Ven We reflect on the rapid rise of Micky van de Ven, tracing his journey from a promising young defender in the Netherlands to becoming one of the Premier League's most electrifying modern centre backs. We sit down with van de Ven to explore the resilience, mentality and sheer speed, on and off the pitch that have defined his ascent.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E33 — Henrik Larsson We delve into the remarkable story of Henrik Larsson, tracing how a young talent from Sweden rose to become one of football's most celebrated forwards. Through candid interviews, Larsson reflects on the work ethic, determination and sharp footballing intelligence that powered his career across Europe and on the international stage. Visiting the clubs, coaches and moments that shaped him, we uncover the milestones, inspirations and unforgettable goals that forged his legacy as a player.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E34 — Fabian Hürzeler We chart the rapid emergence of Fabian Hürzeler, tracing his evolution from a young, inexperienced coach in his native Germany to becoming one of the Premier League's most progressive managerial voices. With unprecedented behind-the-scenes access at Brighton, Hürzeler opens up on the ideas, influences and leadership principles shaping his footballing philosophy. Revisiting the environments and mentors that defined him, we uncover the innovation that has powered his impact at the highest level.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E35 — Deadline Day Drama As the January transfer window reaches its dramatic conclusion, we explore the evolution of the Premier League's transfer market, from its early years to the high-stakes, global spectacle it is today. Revisiting some of the biggest and most transformative deals in Premier League history, we uncover the moments, motivations and manoeuvres that reshaped clubs and careers. Blending archive, insight and reflection, we reveal how deadline-day drama has come to define the modern Premier League era.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E36 — Antonio Valencia In the heart of Ecuador, we sit down with Antonio Valencia as he reflects on an extraordinary journey from humble beginnings to the grand stages of world football. Against the backdrop of the streets and stadiums that shaped him, he recounts his rise through adversity, his explosive emergence in the Premier League with Wigan, and his evolution into a title-winning, Champions League-chasing leader at Manchester United.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E37 — Andoni Iraola Andoni Iraola went from relative obscurity to leading a once relegation-threatened club to its highest ever points tally in the Premier League. We explore how his fearless philosophy, tactical innovation and emotional connection to the game have driven his teams to challenge expectations and rewrite their identity. A story of a Basque footballing icon, and his remarkable journey from Cyprus to the Premier League with Bournemouth in 5 years.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E38 — Shinji Okazaki With exclusive access in Germany, PL Stories follows the remarkable journey of Shinji Okazaki; from his beginnings in Japanese football to becoming a Premier League champion with Leicester City and now shaping the next generation through his club Basara Mainz.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E39 — Iliman Ndiaye Fresh from lifting the Africa Cup of Nations trophy with Senegal, Iliman Ndiaye reflects on a journey defined by resilience, imagination and quiet determination. From the academy pitches of France to the unforgiving grounds of non-league Boreham Wood, and on to the bright lights of the Premier League with Everton, we trace a rise that defied convention and expectation at every turn.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E40 — PGMO and International Women's Day We mark International Women's Day by celebrating the women shaping refereeing across the professional game. We explore the past, present and future of officiating, spending a day on the road with PGMO officials Natalie Aspinall, Kirsty Dowle and Emily Carney as they open up about their journeys to the top of the game.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.title: Premier League Stories

Alongside this new pursuit, Yakubu reflects on his remarkable journey from his early years in Nigeria to becoming one of the Premier League's most prolific and respected strikers.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E45 — Victor Moses Victor Moses looks back on his rise through English football, culminating in Premier League title success with Chelsea, while also opening up about the challenges faced along the way. programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E46 — Tijjani Reijnders We step inside the world of Tijjani Reijnders, joining him at home with his family in Manchester as he reflects on his remarkable rise to the top of the game. programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E47 — Norwegian Strikers We celebrate the rise of Norwegian striking power in the Premier League, exploring how a golden generation in the late 1990s, featuring pioneers like Ole Gunnar Solskjær and Tore André Flo helped shatter stereotypes and establish Norway as an unlikely breeding ground for elite forwards. A PL Stories show that asks whether the qualities that once defined a nation's footballing identity still pulse through the DNA of its most unstoppable striker today.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S5 E48 — Dimitar Berbatov We speak to Dimitar Berbatov, a player whose elegance and composure left a lasting imprint on English football.
